scope.summary: Register the BodyKit ValidationDescriptor catalog per Section 13.27: BODY_TOPOLOGY_VALID, BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID, BODY_POSE_RANGE_VALID, EXPORT_BODY_VALID, GENITAL_BLEND_VALID, and LICENSE_GUARD wired into the 13.15 validation runner with correct stage bindings, machine-readable result schemas, and fail-closed semantics for the license tripwire.
acceptance_criteria: All six descriptors register in the validation catalog with stable ids, severity, stage bindings (BODY_TOPOLOGY/DECOUPLE at authoring, BODY_POSE_RANGE at pose/bake, EXPORT_BODY at export, GENITAL_BLEND at skin/genital change, LICENSE_GUARD at every asset ingest), and versioned result schemas.

The 13.15 runner executes each descriptor in its bound stage against the implementations delivered by earlier MTs (MT-485 topology, MT-641 decouple matrix, MT-642 pose matrix, MT-622 export report, MT-558 blend check, MT-488 tripwire).
GENITAL_BLEND_VALID verifies the genital skin blend across the seeded skin-tone sweep including the darkest tones (the Golden-Palace white-skins failure as a descriptor-level check).
LICENSE_GUARD is fail-closed: an unclassifiable or guard-tripping asset blocks the operation with a typed reason; there is no warn-and-continue path for license findings.
A catalog enumeration test asserts all six descriptors (plus their result schemas) are present and runnable; descriptor results land on BodyValidationReceipt findings.
scope.risk_if_missed: Validation stays a pile of ad-hoc test functions with no runner integration — receipts can't cite descriptors, promotion can't gate on them, and the license tripwire (a legal-exposure control) is skippable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
